using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Graphics;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic.Tests
{
	public class RegisteredProfileTooltipLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task ConstructorStartsHttpClientGetAsyncCall()
		{
			// Arrange
			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			widgetMock.Setup(w => w.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(widgetMock.Object);
			widgetMock.Setup(w => w.Get<LabelWidget>(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new Mock<LabelWidget>().Object);

			var worldRendererMock = new Mock<WorldRenderer>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var playerDatabaseMock = new Mock<PlayerDatabase>();
			playerDatabaseMock.Setup(p => p.Profile).Returns("https://example.com/profile/");
			modDataMock.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<PlayerDatabase>()).Returns(playerDatabaseMock.Object);

			var clientMock = new Mock<Session.Client>();
			clientMock.Setup(c => c.Fingerprint).Returns("test-fingerprint");

			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var httpResponseMock = new Mock<HttpResponseMessage>(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK);
			var streamMock = new Mock<Stream>();
			httpResponseMock.Setup(r => r.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync()).ReturnsAsync(streamMock.Object);
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(httpResponseMock.Object);

			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => httpClientMock.Object;

			try
			{
				// Act
				var logic = new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widgetMock.Object, worldRendererMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, clientMock.Object);

				// Assert - verify the GetAsync call was made with expected URL
				httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync("https://example.com/profile/test-fingerprint"), Times.Once);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = HttpClientFactory.Create; // Reset
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task ConstructorHandlesHttpClientExceptionGracefully()
		{
			// Arrange
			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			widgetMock.Setup(w => w.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(widgetMock.Object);
			widgetMock.Setup(w => w.Get<LabelWidget>(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new Mock<LabelWidget>().Object);

			var worldRendererMock = new Mock<WorldRenderer>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var playerDatabaseMock = new Mock<PlayerDatabase>();
			playerDatabaseMock.Setup(p => p.Profile).Returns("https://example.com/profile/");
			modDataMock.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<PlayerDatabase>()).Returns(playerDatabaseMock.Object);

			var clientMock = new Mock<Session.Client>();
			clientMock.Setup(c => c.Fingerprint).Returns("test-fingerprint");

			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Test exception"));

			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => httpClientMock.Object;

			try
			{
				// Act
				var logic = new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widgetMock.Object, worldRendererMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, clientMock.Object);

				// Assert - verify exception handling by checking GetAsync was called
				httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.Is<string>(url => url.EndsWith("test-fingerprint"))), Times.Once);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = HttpClientFactory.Create; // Reset
			}
		}
	}
}

			var originalCreate = typeof(OpenRA.Mods.Common.HttpClientFactory).GetMethod("Create", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
			var createCalled = false;
			
			try
